title: Symmetric Tree
statement: Return true when the binary tree is a mirror of itself around its center.
hints: The tree is symmetric when the left subtree is a mirror of the right subtree.
Two trees are mirrors when their roots match and each left child mirrors the other right child.
A null pair matches. One null does not.

approaches.name: Recursive mirror check
approaches.explanation: Compare outside children and inside children.

editorial: Call a helper on (left, right). It returns true when both are null, false when one is null or the values differ, and otherwise checks mirror(left.left, right.right) and mirror(left.right, right.left). The root itself has no partner. Its two children do.

examples.explanation: The inner children are not mirrored.
